applicableDomain: Clinical Laboratory & ISO 15189 Diagnostic Specimen Fulfillment
descriptionAndPurpose: Independently executable child subworkflow routing signed laboratory orders into phlebotomy/specimen collection and analytical processing queues, evaluating service-level financial clearance, preventing duplicate active tasks on replay, and routing verified or amended results back to the responsible clinician inbox.
prerequisiteConditions: Signed laboratory order exists with valid LOINC test identifier.
Idempotency key verified in DurableProcessedEventRepository to prevent duplicate task creation.
safetyChecks: Two-identifier patient verification at specimen collection.
Delta-check and critical panic-value detection immediately triggers CLINICIAN_CRITICAL_RESULT_ESCALATION.
Amended results reopen clinician inbox review even if initial result was previously acknowledged.
financialAndAuthorizationPolicies: Service-level LABORATORY clearance evaluated via WorkflowBillingClearancePolicySpi.
Financial hold retains order intact and activates LAB_COLLECTION queue immediately upon ServiceCleared.
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Order cancellation before specimen collection marks queue entry CANCELLED; recollection resumes at LAB_COLLECTION_QUEUED under the same orderId without duplicating billing.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: ISO 15189 chain-of-custody audit log capturing collector, accession barcode, analyzer ID, verifier credentials, and timestamp.
completionCriteria: Final laboratory report verified by authorized laboratory scientist/pathologist and durably delivered to responsible clinician inbox.
